features.text: Patient reports anxiety that was severe in November and December, but is currently manageable.
Anxiety episodes typically started during the day at work.
Anxiety was linked to premenstrual periods before becoming random.
Patient stopped taking Camila birth control and experienced increased hunger.
Patient has lost weight over the past six months.
Patient has a history of anxiety and was prescribed Singulair by Dr. Ward.
Patient was on progesterone for regulating periods.
Patient has a history of cervical cancer screening (Pap smear) in 2009.
Patient is vaccinated against COVID-19, and her son has received the first dose.
Patient is concerned about her family's hesitancy regarding the vaccine.
Patient has a family history of breast cancer (mother diagnosed at 45).
Patient has breast lumps that have decreased in size but are still present.
Patient reports breast tenderness in the left side, which was also present during breastfeeding.
Patient has a history of breast cysts and fibroadenomas.
Patient is currently using a medication for breast issues, taken once a week.
Patient is considering a referral to a breast specialist for further evaluation.
